units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 33:28">Targ. Job XXXIII, 28</cite> <he>נהורא מ׳</he> the perfect light (of the hereafter).—
<cite ref="Gittin 29a:19">Gitt. 29ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>גיטא מ׳ הוי</he> a valid divorce.
<cite ref="Berakhot 11b:4">Ber. 11ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לישנא מ׳</he> a more appropriate expression, opp. <he>דבר מגונה</he>, v. <cite ref="C01098"><he>גָּנָה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shevuot 45b:8">Shebu. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה מ׳ הא שמעתא</he> how fine an argument is this!; a. fr.—Pl. f. <cite ref="M02135"><he>מַעַלְיָיתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:16">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>מהני מילי מ׳ וכ׳</he> one of those fine sayings of thine concerning &c.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:20">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 20</cite> <cite ref="M02134"><he>מעליא</he></cite>, some ed., v. <cite ref="M02139"><he>מַעֲלָנָא</he></cite>.]
